mapper.sql: m.msg_id, m.sender_id, s.name AS sender_name, sd.dept_nm AS sender_dept, m.receiver_id, r.name AS receiver_name, m.content, m.read_at, m.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_message (sender_id, receiver_id, content) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_message SET read_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE msg_id = #{msgId} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND read_at IS NULL
UPDATE gw_message SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE msg_id = #{msgId} AND (sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gw_message m LEFT JOIN gw_user s ON s.user_id = m.sender_id LEFT JOIN gw_user r ON r.user_id = m.receiver_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept sd ON sd.dept_id = s.dept_id WHERE m.msg_id = #{msgId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT FROM gw_message m LEFT JOIN gw_user s ON s.user_id = m.sender_id LEFT JOIN gw_user r ON r.user_id = m.receiver_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept sd ON sd.dept_id = s.dept_id WHERE m.receiver_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 200
